text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, everyone!
Replacing the former president, from today onwards, I am the president!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I'll raise you into the strongest business syndicate and conquer the top of the industry... Hey, what's all the racket?! We're basking in the afterglow of victory right now—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Whaaat?! Company A launched an M&A bid against us, you say?!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh!! And then what!?
What happeneth next!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason was so engrossed in reading
a novel about rising to power from humble beginnings
that she ended up staying up late...
